newsitem.title: BELGIUM: TENNIS-BECKER FIT FOR EUROPEAN COMMUNITY TOURNAMENT.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-BECKER FIT FOR EUROPEAN COMMUNITY TOURNAMENT.

text.p: Boris Becker has recovered from a wrist injury which forced him out of last week's Dubai Open and will compete in this week's European Community championship.
"He has arrived, and he's here to play," tournament director Georges Baudeweyns said on Monday.
The recurring problem forced Becker, seeded fourth in Antwerp, to withdraw in Dubai minutes before his quarter-final against Goran Ivanisevic last Friday.
"Becker is smart, he did the most sensible thing he could do -- stop as soon as he felt something, he did not try to play on," Baudeweyns said.
Becker was scheduled to face Czech Petr Korda in the first round on on Wednesday.
